$description: Sunken - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Sunken
line: Ruins under the sea: carved stone panels, light falling through water, kelp and fish drifting past, and a few places to dive in.

voice.searchph: Search the ruins: components, tokens, patterns
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, carved in stone and left where the light still reaches.
voice.lede.worlds: One system, many worlds. This one lies underwater: carved stone panels, light falling through the sea, and kelp and fish drifting past.
voice.lede.typography: Cinzel is cut like an inscription, for titles; Alegreya Sans carries the reading; the italic accent is Alegreya; labels are its small capitals.
voice.lede.card: A slab of sandstone with a carved inner border; under the pointer it rises a little through the water.
voice.lede.button: A coral stone that presses into the sea floor. A success sends up a stream of bubbles.
voice.lede.404: Nothing down here but sand. Search, or swim back to the first page.
voice.copyfail: Lost to the current - select the code instead
